decisions.reason: The modular plant concept has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year and matches the firm's announced modular direction, so management will keep investing in it despite no new 2024 web presence being reported.

As the publicly presented multi-model flagship of the modular, cleaner-technology direction, it carries the highest sunk investment and visible commitment, so any quiet results would be treated as temporary ramp-up.

The trommel screen is a core complement to the firm's mobile processing chains and the firm is growing, though as a single model close to the existing range it is more open to being superseded by newer screening lines such as F.
The newly launched multi-model slow-speed shredder line has its own page and likely replaced Product B, so it has fresh investment and public commitment that management will defend.

The 2024 multi-model spiral shaft screen line is newly and prominently presented, fits the modular expansion of the screening range, and is too young for disappointing results to be judged as anything but temporary.
